candidate_windows.window_text:
All our experiments were carried out on a single server with one NVIDIA Quadro GP100 GPU. The total computation time for generating and scoring translations was less than 24 hours.

To compute BLEU and $\mathrm{ChrF + + }$ we use the SacreBLEU package with the default parameters. For COMET and COMET-QE, we use the COMET package with the wmt20-comet-da and wmt20-comet-que-da-v2 models, respectively. The translation hypotheses, Seq-Logprob, and LASER are computed using the Fairseq framework. To compute ALTI+, we adapt the code by Ferrando et al. (2022). For the inference of LaBSE and the XNLI model, we use the transformers package.
